name: prism-rules-lane-divergence
title: Repository prism rules never reach the sd-review lane
description: The sd-review local provider builds its own prism command and omits --rules, --exclude, and --fail-on, so .prism/rules.json applies only in the shell review lane. Every repository-owned prism rule is silently inert under sd-review, which is the lane sd-ship Stage 2 uses. Decide between documenting the divergence locally and proposing an upstream fix to the built-in prism adapter.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Observed on PR #158 (2026-08-06): prism reported the generated _example scaffold rows that .prism/rules.json's trellis-scaffold-convention rule (added by PR #156 to prevent exactly that) forbids reporting. Note that scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-review-local.py is installed from the sd-ai-command-pack (.sd-ai-command-pack/manifest.json) and is provenance-tracked and undrifted, so changing the built-in prism adapter is upstream work; .prism/rules.json is install: if-not-exists and therefore repo-owned. One of the vendored-artifact instances enumerated in the canonical table in 08-07-vendored-artifact-upstream-route/prd.md, which consolidates the pattern; no count or membership list is restated here. Sequencing: this task writes .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md at order 30 in the P2 band; write-set membership and the band-aware landing sequence are documented in .trellis/tasks/08-08-trellis-backlog-hygiene/record.md.
